name: Residential Lease Agreement
description: A contract between a landlord and tenant setting out the terms for renting a residential property.
content:
RESIDENTIAL LEASE AGREEMENT

This Residential Lease Agreement ("Agreement") is entered into between:

{{landlord_name}}, located at {{landlord_address}} ("Landlord"),

and

{{tenant_name}} ("Tenant").

1. PROPERTY
The Landlord agrees to rent to the Tenant the residential property located at:
{{property_address}} (the "Property").

2. LEASE TERM
This lease shall commence on {{lease_start_date}} and shall expire on {{lease_end_date}} (the "Lease Term"). Unless renewed in writing, the Tenant shall vacate the Property on or before the expiry date.

3. RENT
The Tenant shall pay a monthly rent of {{monthly_rent}} {{rent_currency}}, due on the {{rent_due_day}}th day of each month. Rent shall be paid by bank transfer or such other method agreed in writing.

4. LATE PAYMENT
If rent is not received within 5 days of the due date, a late fee of {{late_fee}} shall apply. Persistent late payment shall constitute grounds for termination of this Agreement.

5. SECURITY DEPOSIT
The Tenant shall pay a security deposit of {{security_deposit}} {{rent_currency}} prior to taking possession of the Property. This deposit shall be returned within 30 days of the Tenant vacating the Property, less any deductions for damages beyond normal wear and tear or outstanding rent.

6. UTILITIES
The following utilities are included in the rent: {{utilities_included}}. All other utilities and services are the sole responsibility of the Tenant.

7. USE OF PROPERTY
The Tenant shall use the Property solely as a private residence and shall not:
a) Sublet or assign the Property without the Landlord's prior written consent;
b) Use the Property for any unlawful purpose;
c) Cause a nuisance to neighbours or other occupants.

8. PETS
Pets: {{pets_allowed}}. Any approved pets must be registered with the Landlord in writing.

9. MAINTENANCE AND REPAIRS
The Tenant shall:
a) Keep the Property clean and in good condition;
b) Promptly notify the Landlord of any damage or required repairs;
c) Not make alterations or improvements without prior written consent.

The Landlord shall be responsible for all structural repairs and maintenance of major systems (plumbing, heating, electrical).

10. ENTRY BY LANDLORD
The Landlord may enter the Property upon giving at least 24 hours' written notice, except in the case of emergency.

11. TERMINATION
Either party may terminate this Agreement at the end of the Lease Term by giving {{notice_period_days}} days' written notice. If neither party provides notice, the lease shall continue on a month-to-month basis under the same terms.

12. EARLY TERMINATION
If the Tenant vacates the Property before the end of the Lease Term without the Landlord's written consent, the Tenant shall remain liable for rent until a replacement tenant is found or the Lease Term expires, whichever is earlier.

13. GOVERNING LAW
This Agreement shall be governed by and construed in accordance with the laws of {{governing_law_state}}.

14. ENTIRE AGREEMENT
This Agreement constitutes the entire agreement between the parties regarding the Property and supersedes all prior discussions and agreements.

IN WITNESS WHEREOF, the parties have signed this Agreement.

_______________________________
{{landlord_name}}
Landlord
